notes.title: August 13th, 2025 Update note v0.73
notes.notes:
-UI overhaul
-added additional map nodes based on road branching logic
-Qingliu Xue and Wuhen Dan base stats adjustments
-no longer gain stats selection when leveling up, reverted back to gain/upgrade cultivation methods
-removed methods from shop and combat rewards, Seclude no longer have option for method upgrade
-leveling up to certain cultivation stages gives specific stat rewards:
Body Foundation: Max HP + 15%
Core Formation: Max Spirit + 1
Nascent Soul: Technique damage dealt + 20%
Soul Transformation：Max HP + 30%
Void Refinement: Max Spirit + 1
Body Integration: Spell block gain + 25%
Great Ascension: Max HP + 45%
Tribulation Crossing: Max Spirit + 1
Xian: After Tribulation, gain Basic Stats based on Aptitude
-Aptitude adjusted to each point + 5% EXP bonus, 1x EXP break through Aptitude +1, 1.5x Aptitude +2, 2x Aptitude +3
-Spirit Reversion no longer provides Spirit
-Tidal Slash Rarity changed to rare
-Enlightenment Rarity changed to uncommon
-Monster HP scaling per level changed to x1.75 from 1.5
-Monster stats scaling per level changed from 1.5 to 1.3

(More contents working in progress, please stay tuned！)

notes.title: July 29th, 2025 Update Note v0.60
notes.notes:
-Added 10 new events to event pool:

1.Broken Sword
remove 1 card and randomly gain 1 Lv.3 Card

2.Sudden Insight
randomly upgrade 2 cards

3.Elemental Stone Tree
randomly acquire/upgrade 1 of the 5 elemental cultivation methods

4.Star Altar
select and upgrade 1 card

5.Sword Cliff
spend 20 years to add Innate to a card

6.Tranquil Pavilion
select and remove 1 card

7.Spirit Stone Vein
gain 100 spirit stone
or gain 300 spirit stone + Desire-Touch

8.Spring of letting go
spend 10 lifespan and remove all distraction cards from deck

9.Enlightenment Stone
spend 3 years to either upgrade, remove or duplicate 1 card

10.Mirror of Introspection
select and duplicate a card

-All events now only show up once per run, except for:
Cave
A place overflowing with spiritual energy
Sudden Insight
Elemental Stone Tree
Spirit Stone Vein

(More contents working in progress, please stay tuned！)

notes.title: July 6, 2025 Update note, v0.33
notes.notes: [p]Map[/p][p]-Map interaction changed to grid based, can move to top, right or bottom if road is connected, can not move left[/p][p]-Map movement lifespan cost increases with zone number, i.e. second zone -2 lifespan per move, third zone -3 (except for moving to town, cave and XiuLuo statue)[/p][p]-Unrevealed map locations now indicate encounter types[/p][p]-Zone order is now random, no longer follows the Wood>Water>Fire order[/p][p]New basic stats[/p][p]-Technique Power effects all Technique Card scaling[/p][p]-Spell Power effects all Spell Card scaling[/p][p]-Mind Power effects all Secret Art Card and Talisman scaling[/p][p]-Crit Chance provides a chance to scale damage dealt by x Crit Damage% [/p][p]-Each point of Aptitude gives 1% EXP bonus, removed EXP bonuses from Comprehension[/p][p]Level up[/p][p]-Mouse hovering on EXP bar now displays current level up lifespan bonuses[/p][p]-No longer gain cultivation method as reward on leveling up, now instead grants basic stat bonuses based on EXP consumed, 1x EXP = 1x stat options, 1.5x EXP = 2x stat options, 2x EXP = 3x stat options[/p][p]The stat options includes:[/p][p]-Lifespan + 10[/p][p]-Max Spirit + 1[/p][p]-Max HP + 20[/p][p]-Comprehension + 8 [/p][p]-Luck + 7[/p][p]-Technique Power + 3 [/p][p]-Spell Power + 3[/p][p]-Mind Power + 3[/p][p]-Crit Chance + 5% [/p][p]-Crit Damage + 10%[/p][p]-Aptitude + 5[/p][p]Seclude[/p][p]-Changed Meditate button to Seclude, Seclude can be initiated any time outside of battles and events, Seclude contains Meditate, Card Upgrade and Method Upgrade[/p][p]-Buffed meditate, now heals 5% HP per year, grants flat 10 EXP per year, can be boosted by Aptitude[/p][p]-Seclude Card Upgrade uses lifespan as resource to upgrade cards[/p][p]-Seclude Method Upgrade uses EXP as resource to upgrade methods[/p][p]Balancing[/p][p]-All cards stats overhaul, upgrading cards now scale their values exponentially, adjusted all cards costs[/p][p]-All enemies damage and HP stats adjusted[/p][p]Events[/p][p]-XiuLuo statue initial lifespan cost reduced to 5(previously 10)[/p][p]-Old man encounter card selection changed to Lv.2 cards[/p][p]-Library 20 pick 1 card selection changed to Lv.1 cards[/p][p]-Adjusted some event choices to have lower Lifespan cost[/p][p]Other[/p][p]-Elites now have a 20% base chance to give a random cultivation method(Lv.1) as reward, Bosses have 50% chance[/p][p]-Removed cave spirit density regeneration mechanic, Cave Card Upgrade no longer requires lifespan[/p][p]-Distraction Cards can now only be used for Lv.1 card upgrades[/p][p]-Reworked Shop layout, added Cultivation Methods, added Restock button (25 spirit stone cost, cost + 25 per use)[/p][p]-Elemental damage bonus changed to 100% (previously 50%)[/p][p]-Armor status changed to reduces 10% when ending turn/taking damage (previously flat -1)[/p][p]-Talisman reworked to scale with Mind Power, some talismans can roll higher levels[/p]
